coverage.positive: Three synthetic 3x3 source shapes, original dyadic tiles, signed boundary-like values, identity product and RNE through the shared owner. Split/out-of-order row blocks, all tested window permutations compared byte-for-byte by a deferred fake-driver observation hook and by scalar fraction-tree root. Root equality alone is permutation-invariant and would be insufficient.
coverage.transfers: After resident producers are prepared, 130 windows add no H2D and no intermediate array D2H; each downloads a 4-byte flag and a 48-byte scalar root. Per-window release restores baseline live capacity.
coverage.canonical_metadata: Actual Canonical adapter executes only a 128-byte all-external-padding window at the end of D34, with no W loaded; unsupported embedding and incomplete W remain rejected.
coverage.negative: 11 Rust gather rejections cover wrong layout/recipe/rows/columns/source, duplicate/missing rows, pending input use, launch/fence/flag failure. Existing 14 Matrix/RNE adapter rejections and canonical negative checks remain green.
coverage.host_owner: UBSan tests 19 gather rejections, independent biased-addition codec boundaries, exact byte order, deferred scatter before source release/reuse, pending flag cleanup; previous 13 range and 23 dense rejections remain. Maximum arena 262144 bytes.
coverage.limitations: The integration proof regression is CPU/small-profile, not a proof consuming this new ByteWindow. No full canonical positive forward, full resident scanner, kernel execution, or complete physical accounting. Kernel enumerates bytes of selected row/tile spans and filters addresses outside the window; not a proven optimal gather workload.
